object: cross-context high-occupancy eigenspaces of mean projectors for frozen bands of normalized reliability-weighted sheaf Laplacians
selection_rule: choose the lowest-frequency band meeting the geometry gate in frozen band order; outcome-based band selection is prohibited

direct_edit_gate.application: prohibited_in_discovery_stage; emit normalized proposal and hash only

controls: outcome-null fixture must fail policy and direct-edit gates
baseline includes norm, Jacobian visibility, and registered nuisance covariates
geometry is discovered before outcomes are accessed
claim_boundary: A pass identifies a stable spectral bundle useful for grouped prediction and bounded candidate allocation. It does not establish real-model self-improvement, compactification, or RSI.
